[element-non-normative-note]
=== `<non-normative-note>` Non-Normative-Note

A non-normative note integrated in the text of a document, used for giving additional information intended to assist the understanding or use of the document or lifecycle or adoption status.

#### Usage/Remarks
A “note” within a standard may be tagged as normative (<<element-normative-note,`<normative-note>`>>), non-normative (<<element-non-normative-note,`<non-normative-note>`>>), or metadata (<<element-meta-note,`<meta-note>`>>), and are typically labeled “Note” or similar.
#### ISO Note

There are no normative notes in ISO standards; all notes are non-normative (<<element-non-normative-note,`<non-normative-note>`>>).

#### Related Elements

This Tag Set contains several elements that are notes or may be used to group notes: <<element-normative-note,`<normative-note>`>> A note with normative content that can be part of the narrative text or inside one of the notes grouping elements in the body text, front matter, or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-non-normative-note,`<non-normative-note>`>> A note with non-normative content that can be part of the narrative text or inside one of the notes grouping elements in the body text, front matter, or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-notes,`<notes>`>> A section containing notes that may appear in the front or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-notes-group,`<notes-group>`>> A headed (titled) group of normative or non-normative notes and examples within the narrative body of a standard or adoption. <<element-meta-note,`<meta-note>`>> A note within the metadata of a standards or adoption document, as opposed to the other note types that occur within the front matter, body, or back matter of a document.

#### Tagged Samples

#### Typical non-normative note

[source,xml]
....
...
<sec id="s6.2">
 <label>6.2</label>
 <title>Selection of equipment for testing</title>
 <p>Tests shall be carried out on at least one unit 
  which has been selected from a production batch in 
  accordance with the manufacturer&rsquo;s quality 
  control sampling scheme.</p>
 <non-normative-note>
  <label>NOTE</label>
  <p>It is in the manufacturer&rsquo;s interest to 
   ensure that the unit selected is representative 
   of its type. Guidance on sampling is given in 
   <std><std-ref type="undated">ISO 2859-1</std-ref
    ></std>.</p>
 </non-normative-note>
</sec>
...
....
#### For Caution

[source,xml]
....
...
<p>Fill one reaction vessel with 5 g of thermostable 
 oil. Insert the temperature sensor through the cap 
 into the reaction vessel. Use distance clips to keep 
 the sensor away from the air inlet.</p>
<non-normative-note content-type="caution">
 <label>CAUTION</label>
 <p>The sensor shall be immersed completely in the oil 
  sample and shall not touch the bottom of the vessel.</p>
</non-normative-note>
<p>Insert the complete vessel into the heating block 
 and connect the air supply.</p>
...
....
